mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it triggers central bank tightening expectations that depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods with CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad consumer demand slowdown that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), rising employment growth (PAYEMS) signals tight labor market conditions that increase corporate wage costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods with UNRATE < 3.5%, PAYEMS growth does not produce negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods with INDPRO MoM < -0.5%, S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and GDP growth indicate a weakening economic cycle that reduces equity risk appetite, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and GDPC1 fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), a rising federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods with CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, rising FEDFUNDS does not produce negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
